Class RMIConnectionHandler

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.Network.Server.Connections.RMIConnectionHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
RMIServerConnection, ServerConnectionHandler, Serializable, Runnable, Remote
public class RMIConnectionHandler extends UnicastRemoteObject implements RMIServerConnection, ServerConnectionHandler
Handles the RMI connection with a client, implementing RMIServerConnection and ServerConnectionHandler.
